entries.60028f4d2d486910: A single-segment business that sells network security products and comprehensively provides product-combination services that draw on the company's security know-how. In addition to importing and selling security products centered on products of Check Point and Menlo (formerly Votiro), the company provides managed security services under its own brand 'Security Plus'. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,434 million for the company as a whole.
entries.92675b6face40f6f: A security solution vendor that sells network security-related products and comprehensively provides product-combination services that make use of its own security know-how.
